title: Rocket Money Subscription Monthly Cost Leaderboard
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rocketmoney:subscription monthly_cost_usd=*
| stats sum(monthly_cost_usd) as total_value, avg(monthly_cost_usd) as avg_value by vendor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks vendor name values by total and average monthly cost across Rocket Money subscription events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `monthly_cost_usd` values for each Rocket Money subscription event and review total and average monthly cost by vendor name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total monthly cost.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which vendor name shows the biggest monthly cost numbers in your Rocket Money subscription data.
